subject: Headcount realignment request — ML infra senior role
messages:
From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 20 Apr 2026 08:12:00 -0700
Subject: Headcount realignment request — ML infra senior role

Team,

Quick context: following calibration for this cycle we have two developments on ML Infrastructure (infra-core): one senior IC has accepted an internal rotation and will move to Product Reliability at end of May; another is likely to take the IC→manager track but has indicated a delayed start for the manager role (Q3). Both moves leave us with a near-term gap on the infra team.

Given the freeze on general hires, I want to propose reallocating the open headcount rather than an immediate backfill. Specifically: repurpose one senior infra headcount to a short-term SRE contractor (6 months) + convert the other into a capacity planner (permanent) focused on inference throughput and batching. This reduces immediate cash spend and aligns to our Q3 roadmap (Optimize).

Attached: HC_Redesign_v2.xlsx (proposed allocations), performance-calibration-notes.txt.

Ask: I need leadership signoff to request a freeze-exception and to route to Finance/PeopleOps. Please reply with either (A) approve the realignment as proposed, (B) approve with caveats (list caveats), or (C) require a full backfill. If possible, reply by EOD Thursday so we can start the approval workflow.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Director, Inference Platform
Redwood Inference
From: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
Cc: Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Tue, 21 Apr 2026 10:05:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount realignment request — ML infra senior role

Tessa — thanks for the clear write-up. A couple of quick questions before I can sign off:

1) Net headcount delta: you're converting two incumbents -> one contractor + one perm role. That means we still need 1.0 FTE approved for the capacity planner, correct?
2) Financial impact: what's the 12-month cash delta (salary + contractor markup)? I know you have numbers in HC_Redesign_v2 but please paste the summary inline for exec review.
3) Risk: what are the critical deliverables at risk if we delay a full senior hire until Q3? Which product milestones are most exposed?

If we need a freeze exception I can route to Finance; I just need the succinct ask and cost delta. I attached reprioritization_matrix.pdf with a suggested canary (start contractor + revisit at 60 days).

Cc: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 22 Apr 2026 09:30:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount realignment request — ML infra senior role

+1 to Tessa's proposal. A few notes from calibration: the two individuals flagged were performance-calibrated and we have documented strengths/weaknesses in performance-calibration-notes.txt. There's no immediate people risk with reassigning the headcount as you describe; it actually addresses two org priorities (reliability + cost).

Suggested operational guardrails:
- Approve the capacity-planner permanent role now (1.0 FTE) but cap backfill offers until 60 days and require a 90-day OKR check-in.
- Use the contractor ramp for the SRE/ops work (6 months), budgeted at ~$110k fully-burdened.
- Document outcomes for the 60-day review and if we still need a senior infra hire, escalate to me and Vivek.

If you want, I can draft the HR justification language for the freeze-exception request (saves time).

From: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>
To: Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>, Katie Ramos <katie@orchardai.com>
Date: Thu, 23 Apr 2026 14:02:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount realignment request — ML infra senior role

Vivek — pasted summary below per your ask. I've looped Katie (external HR consultant) for the freeze-exception wording and any PeopleOps process questions.

Summary (12-month view):
- Current plan: convert two incumbents into 1x contractor (6 months) + 1x permanent capacity planner.
- 12-month cash delta vs full backfill: ~-$95k (savings) — contractor + capacity planner < cost of two senior hires. Detailed numbers in HC_Redesign_v2.xlsx (tab: Financials).
- Product risk: delayed senior hire increases time to complete Sequence Cache project by ~8 weeks (affects Q3 API throughput targets) but contractor can mitigate immediate rollout risk for 6 months.

Caveats: contractor ramp will require a stronger handover (we'll allocate 0.2 FTE from current senior IC to assist for 4 weeks). If approved, I'll create a shortened onboarding checklist for the contractor and capture OKRs for the capacity planner.

Katie — can you confirm the documentation needed for the freeze-exception and whether the contractor route triggers any different approvals from PeopleOps?

Thanks —
Tessa
From: Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
To: Tessa Morgan <tessa_morgan@redwood.com>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.com>, Neha Kapoor <neha_kapoor@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 28 Apr 2026 11:47:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Headcount realignment request — ML infra senior role

Thanks for the thoughtful plan. I approve the realignment with the following conditions:

1) 90-day OKR checkpoint for the capacity planner with a specified list of deliverables (latency target, KV cache defaults, one automated load test).
2) Finance must confirm the contractor ceiling and the cost code before we onboard.
3) Tessa, please include a customer-impact statement in the freeze-exception packet describing how this reduces near-term cost while maintaining core SLA obligations.

Once those three items are in the packet, I authorize Vivek to route to Finance and PeopleOps for formal freeze-exception approval.

Date: Sat, 02 May 2026 16:28:00 -0700
Subject: APPROVED: Headcount realignment -> route for freeze-exception

Folks — per Laura's conditions and Neha's draft language, I approve the realignment and authorize routing for a freeze-exception for 1.0 FTE (capacity planner) and contractor onboarding (6 months).

Action items for routing:
- Tessa: attach the 90-day OKR list + customer-impact statement in the packet (link to Confluence: https://redwood.atlassian.net/l/c/HC-Realignment-2026).
- Katie/PeopleOps: confirm required fields and the PeopleOps queue ID; is the external contractor arrangement flagged differently?
- Finance Approvals: please confirm the cost code and contractor ceiling (Finance, respond with confirmation and a Jira ticket if you need more details).

Attached: HC_Redesign_v2.xlsx, reprioritization_matrix.pdf.

Thanks — Vivek Kulkarni
VP, Platform Operations
Redwood Inference
